gaps.zh: 医生说这位___要多休息。
gaps.en: The doctor says this patient needs to rest more.

gaps.zh: 有___来我们家，妈妈做了很多菜。
gaps.en: Guests are coming to our home, so Mom has cooked a lot of dishes.

gaps.zh: 八十岁的___很喜欢在公园里走走。
gaps.en: Old people of eighty like taking a walk in the park.

hubs.en: a noun ending (not a word by itself here)

gaps.zh: 她穿了一条红色的___，很漂亮。
gaps.en: She is wearing a red skirt, and it is very pretty.

gaps.zh: 我们的___有三个房间，不太大。
gaps.en: Our house has three rooms and is not very big.

gaps.zh: 这个___里有很多行李。
gaps.en: There is a lot of luggage in this suitcase.

gaps.zh: 桌子上有一个___，里面有水。
gaps.en: There is a bottle on the table, and there is water in it.

gaps.zh: 中国的___很冷，冬天常常下雪。
gaps.en: The north of China is very cold, and it often snows in winter.

gaps.zh: 请问，去火车站是这个___吗？
gaps.en: Excuse me, is this the direction to the train station?

gaps.zh: 学汉语有很多好___。
gaps.en: There are many good ways to learn Chinese.

gaps.zh: 这个___很安静，我喜欢来这儿看书。
gaps.en: This place is very quiet, and I like coming here to read.

gaps.zh: 对不起，我今天___了。路上的车太多了。
gaps.en: Sorry, I was late today. There were too many cars on the road.

gaps.zh: 我昨天___了朋友的邮件。
gaps.en: Yesterday I received an email from my friend.

gaps.zh: 在回家的路上，我___了一个老同学。
gaps.en: On the way home, I ran into an old classmate.

gaps.zh: 她很努力，所以___了很好的成绩。
gaps.en: She works hard, so she got very good results.

gaps.zh: ___很冷，常常下雪。
gaps.en: Winter is very cold, and it often snows.

gaps.zh: 今天是星期五，___是星期天。
gaps.en: Today is Friday, and the day after tomorrow is Sunday.

gaps.zh: 我等了你___，你怎么现在才来？
gaps.en: I have waited for you for ages. Why have you only come now?

gaps.zh: ___来了，花都开了，天气也不冷了。
gaps.en: Spring has come, all the flowers have opened, and the weather is no longer cold.

hubs.en: to send out; to set off

gaps.zh: 我们明天早上六点___，别迟到。
gaps.en: We set off at six tomorrow morning, so do not be late.

gaps.zh: 她昨天晚上___了，今天不能去上班。
gaps.en: She had a fever yesterday evening, so she cannot go to work today.

gaps.zh: 我在书里___了一张旧照片。
gaps.en: I found an old photo in the book.

gaps.zh: 昨天学校里___了一件事，你知道吗？
gaps.en: Something happened at school yesterday. Do you know about it?

gaps.zh: 你___，我会照顾好你的孩子。
gaps.en: Rest assured. I will take good care of your child.

gaps.zh: 路上有水，请___。
gaps.en: There is water on the road, so please be careful.

gaps.zh: 今天是我的生日，朋友们都来了，我很___。
gaps.en: Today is my birthday and all my friends came, so I am very happy.

gaps.zh: 妈妈很___我，她每天都问我吃饭了吗。
gaps.en: Mom cares about me a lot. Every day she asks me if I have eaten.

gaps.zh: 上课的时候请___，不要看手机。
gaps.en: Please turn off your phone in class, and do not look at it.

gaps.zh: 他是出租车___，每天开八个小时的车。
gaps.en: He is a taxi driver, and he drives eight hours every day.

gaps.zh: 我想用___照相。
gaps.en: I want to take photos with the camera.

gaps.zh: 地铁上人很多，我用___听音乐。
gaps.en: There are many people on the subway, so I listen to music with headphones.

gaps.zh: 你和他是什么___？
gaps.en: What is your relationship with him?

gaps.zh: 这本书是___中国历史的。
gaps.en: This book is about Chinese history.

gaps.zh: 最近很多人都在___这个新闻。
gaps.en: Lately many people are following this piece of news.

gaps.zh: 这件事跟你___吗？
gaps.en: Is this matter connected with you?

gaps.zh: 我先去银行，___去超市。
gaps.en: I will go to the bank first, and then go to the supermarket.

gaps.zh: 今年我二十岁，___我二十二岁。
gaps.en: I am 20 this year, and the year after next I will be 22.

gaps.zh: 这是___一次考试，我要认真考。
gaps.en: This is the last exam, so I want to take it seriously.

gaps.zh: 下课___，我们一起去吃饭吧。
gaps.en: After class, let us go and eat together.

gaps.zh: 今天星期三，___是星期一。
gaps.en: Today is Wednesday, and the day before yesterday was Monday.

gaps.zh: 老师站在我们___，给我们讲课。
gaps.en: The teacher stands in front of us and gives us a lesson.

gaps.zh: 他二十岁___没有学过汉语。
gaps.en: He had not studied Chinese before he was twenty.

gaps.zh: ___我们去中国旅游了，今年没有去。
gaps.en: The year before last we travelled in China; this year we have not gone.

gaps.zh: 这些书___三十块。
gaps.en: These books are thirty yuan in all.

gaps.zh: 明天___会下雨，你要带伞。
gaps.en: It will certainly rain tomorrow, so you should take an umbrella.

gaps.zh: 我和姐姐的衣服___大。
gaps.en: My sister's clothes and mine are the same size.

gaps.zh: 他___走路，一边听音乐。
gaps.en: He walks while listening to music.

hubs.en: marks a limit in time, place or number

gaps.zh: 除了汉语___，你还会说别的外语吗？
gaps.en: Besides Chinese, can you speak any other foreign language?

gaps.zh: 你来___，请先给我打电话。
gaps.en: Before you come, please call me first.

gaps.zh: 考试成绩在八十___的同学不用复习。
gaps.en: Students whose test results are eighty or above do not have to review.

gaps.zh: 我们吃饭___去看电影吧。
gaps.en: After eating, let us go and see a film.

gaps.zh: 我们在___上坐一会儿吧，这儿很舒服。
gaps.en: Let us sit on the grass for a while; it is comfortable here.

gaps.zh: 我看不懂这张___，你能帮我吗？
gaps.en: I cannot read this map. Can you help me?

gaps.zh: 我是___人，不太知道这里的路。
gaps.en: I am from out of town, and I do not know the roads here very well.

gaps.zh: 会议的___在三楼的办公室。
gaps.en: The place of the meeting is the office on the third floor.

gaps.zh: ___的时候，我们会吃饺子。
gaps.en: At New Year we will eat dumplings.

gaps.zh: 他是三___的学生，学习很努力。
gaps.en: He is a third-year student and studies very hard.

gaps.zh: 她很___，只有二十岁。
gaps.en: She is very young, only twenty.

hubs.en: to shine; to photograph; to look after

gaps.zh: 出国要带好你的___。
gaps.en: When you go abroad, you need to bring your passport.

gaps.zh: 这是我们去年在公园照的___。
gaps.en: This is a photo we took in the park last year.

gaps.zh: 妈妈生病了，我要回家___她。
gaps.en: Mom is ill, so I want to go home and look after her.

gaps.zh: 这儿很漂亮，我们___吧。
gaps.en: It is beautiful here. Let us take some photos.

gaps.zh: 这个考试很___，你要认真复习。
gaps.en: This exam is very important, so you should review carefully.

gaps.zh: 我们___你的帮助。
gaps.en: We need your help.

gaps.zh: 老师___我们每天写一个句子。
gaps.en: The teacher requires us to write a sentence every day.

gaps.zh: 我的___工作是照顾病人。
gaps.en: My main job is looking after patients.

gaps.zh: 朋友要去国外留学，我很___。
gaps.en: My friend is going to study abroad, and I feel sad.

gaps.zh: 这个字写得很___，我看不清楚。
gaps.en: This character is written very badly, and I cannot see it clearly.

gaps.zh: 他唱歌很___，我不想听。
gaps.en: He sings very badly, and I do not want to listen.

gaps.zh: 这个数学___我做了半天也没做好。
gaps.en: I worked on this maths problem for ages and still did not get it done.

gaps.zh: 下个月学校___，我们去旅游。
gaps.en: School closes for the holiday next month, and we are going travelling.

gaps.zh: 我生病了，要给老师___。
gaps.en: I am ill and need to ask the teacher for leave.

gaps.zh: 这个___我想去海边玩。
gaps.en: This holiday I want to go and play at the seaside.

gaps.zh: 春天是我最喜欢的___。
gaps.en: Spring is my favourite season.

gaps.zh: 今天晚上有一个很有意思的电视___。
gaps.en: There is a very interesting TV programme tonight.

gaps.zh: 新年是一个很大的___，大家都放假。
gaps.en: New Year is a big festival, and everyone has a holiday.

gaps.zh: 我们家来了___，妈妈在做饭。
gaps.en: Guests have come to our home, and Mom is cooking.

gaps.zh: 今天我___，大家想吃什么都可以。
gaps.en: Today it is my treat, so everyone can have whatever they want.

gaps.zh: 明天我要去朋友家___。
gaps.en: Tomorrow I am going to my friend's home as a guest.

gaps.zh: 很多___来这个城市旅游。
gaps.en: Many tourists come to this city to travel.

gaps.en: We finish school at half past three.

gaps.zh: 他想去国外___。
gaps.en: He wants to study abroad.

gaps.zh: 新的___从九月开始。
gaps.en: The new term starts in September.

gaps.zh: 我的___老师是一位女士。
gaps.en: My maths teacher is a woman.

hubs.en: to be born; to live; student

gaps.zh: 他是二十年前___的。
gaps.en: He was born twenty years ago.

gaps.en: There are twenty boys in our class and fifteen girls.

gaps.zh: 你为什么这么___？
gaps.en: Why are you so angry?

gaps.zh: 他在国外的___很快乐。
gaps.en: His life abroad is very happy.

gaps.zh: 过马路的时候要___车。
gaps.en: When you cross the road, you need to watch out for cars.

gaps.zh: 老师对我的成绩很___。
gaps.en: The teacher is very pleased with my results.

gaps.en: Are you willing to go with me?

gaps.zh: 这两个字的意思___。
gaps.en: The meanings of these two characters are different.

gaps.zh: 你___给我买东西，我有。
gaps.en: You do not need to buy me anything; I have some.

gaps.zh: 他住院了，___就会回家。
gaps.en: He is in hospital, but he will be home soon.

gaps.zh: 我找了半天，书包还是___了。
gaps.en: I looked for ages, but my schoolbag is still missing.

gaps.zh: 他们在三楼的办公室___，现在不能进去。
gaps.en: They are in a meeting in the office on the third floor, so you cannot go in now.

gaps.zh: 这是一个很好的___，你应该试一试。
gaps.en: This is a very good chance; you should give it a try.

gaps.zh: 新年___上有很多好看的节目。
gaps.en: There are many good programmes at the New Year party.

gaps.en: How many foreign languages can you speak?

gaps.zh: 今天太累了，我们点___吧。
gaps.en: We are too tired today. Let us order takeaway.

gaps.en: He is from another part of the country and has worked here for three years.

gaps.en: It has turned cold, so you should wear an overcoat.

gaps.en: It is raining, so I go out in a raincoat.

gaps.zh: 我想买一件___和一条黑色的裤子。
gaps.en: I want to buy a top and a pair of black trousers.

opps.note: 东 is east and 西 is west. Put them together and you get 东西 (dōngxi), which means "things".
南 is south and 北 is north. 南方 and 北方 are the south and the north of a country.
The East and the West. Both end in 方 (side).
The south and the north of a country. 中国的北方很冷，南方很热。
Northeast and southwest. 东 swaps with 西 and 北 swaps with 南.
Southeast and northwest, the other pair of corners.
Fat and thin. Be careful: saying 你很胖 to a person is rude.
Hungry and full: 我饿了, 我饱了.
Easy and hard. Both go with 很: 很容易, 很难.
Happy and sad. Both tell how you feel: 我很开心, 我很难过.
Clean and dirty: 房间很干净, 手很脏.
Old and young, for people: 老人 and 年轻人.
开 turns it on and 关 turns it off. Both end in 机 (machine).
Go into hospital and leave hospital. 院 stays the same. 住 is to stay and 出 is to go out.
Before and after. Both start with 以.
Above (or more than) and below (or less than). Both start with 以.
The day before yesterday and the day after tomorrow. 前 is before and 后 is after, both with 天 (day).
The year before last and the year after next. 前 is before and 后 is after, both with 年 (year).
Summer is hot and winter is cold. Both end in 天.
Spring and autumn, the two mild seasons.
Man and woman. Both end in 人 (person).
Boy and girl students. Both end in 生 (student).
发 sends and 收 receives: 发邮件, 收邮件.
To get something and to lose it.
To remember and to forget. 忘记 has 记 inside it, and 忘 means to lose from the mind.
To worry and to set your mind at rest. Both end in 心 (heart): 担 carries the worry and 放 puts it down.
The same and different. 不 turns 同 (same) into 不同 (not the same).
好久 is a long time and 不久 is not long. You also hear 好久不见 when you meet an old friend.
阿姨 is a woman about your mother's age and 叔叔 is a man about your father's age.
